sections.label: Sandy reef bed
sections.evidence: Broad tan footprints at y=0–2 form the seabed, with a small orange cluster at x=12–15, z=4–6.

sections.label: Reef shoulders and station floor
sections.evidence: Dark-gray masses flank the center; light-gray strips rise at x=8 and x=16. White bricks at y=6 and yellow bricks at y=7 establish the station footprint.

sections.label: Rocky reef outcrops
sections.evidence: Tan margins surround dark-gray outcrops on both sides of the station. Red growth at x=3, z=5 and green growth near x=19–22, z=17–19 rise among the rocks.

sections.label: Station shell and surrounding reef
sections.evidence: White shell bricks spread across x=7–17 at y=8–9 above a yellow floor. Interleaved dark-gray bricks extend the neighboring reef through y=7.

sections.label: Cabin walls and windows
sections.evidence: Blue blocks form a broad front window at z=5–9 and a rear window at z=17–19. Yellow borders and white cabin walls surround them through y=11.

sections.label: Cabin roof and mast
sections.evidence: The white footprint narrows at y=12–13 around a dark-gray cap at x=10–14, z=10–14. Yellow #567–568 rise above it; remaining additions include rear shell and window pieces.

sections.label: Cabin side walls
sections.evidence: A blue window with white edging occupies x=17–19, y=8–11. The following white strips form the opposite cabin side at x=6.

sections.label: Gray side panel
sections.evidence: Light-gray bricks build a vertical panel at x=3–5, z=11–15, y=6–9, beside a yellow strip at x=5, y=7–9.

sections.label: Window trim and antenna
sections.evidence: Paired yellow additions at x=9 and x=14 extend the front window border through y=12. White #569 forms a narrow element above the central mast at y=17.

sections.label: Orange coral growth
sections.evidence: Orange bricks rise from z=5–7 and spread across x=18–23 at y=5–7 before narrowing at y=8, forming a distinct reef growth.

sections.label: Reef edges and antenna arms
sections.evidence: Tan and dark-gray pieces extend the outer reef edges through y=7. White #570–574 occupy y=17 around the central antenna element.
